classification.difficultyReason: The number line gives A and B. Part a asks directly for their difference, which needs a subtraction of a negative (-2-(-8)=6). Part b reuses that result: the equal-difference condition means moving 6 right from B. The scaffolding does the planning, leaving two short, linked steps. It needs slightly more than a single direct application such as the straight-line angle reference. It needs less than translating a word problem into an integer addition.
